fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-11-05, the owner of Green Leaf Stores reported that cash of around Rs. 25,000 was taken under threat at Alli Park Shopping Complex in Salem. The time of the incident was given as 17:15 on 2025-11-05. Bharath Gopal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000314. The complainant is associated with the business Green Leaf Stores. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Anitha Raman was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The complainant noted the registration number TN-45-XX-1036 of a green scooter.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects allegedly entered near closing time and threatened the staff. A scooter was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: shop robbery, cash, scooter, CCTV, shopping complex, witness statement, witness, evening
